correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic checker reconstructs the six rational off-diagonal entries in independent positive variables from full 4×4 matrix inverse. The endstep is symmetric positive definite with row sum 1, so all diagonal entries positive. Polynomial coefficient ordering and Descartes plus endpoints show each off-diagonal has either no zero or exactly one positive crossing. Leading quartic inequalities yield iff reciprocal-conductance condition. Highest coefficient and positive denominator yield h^(-1) and critical h^(-2) laws. Exact examples and 540 direct numerical matrix checks corroborate without replacing infinite proof.

value.rationale: A-stability and mass conservation do not guarantee nonnegative stochastic transition coefficients. The exact conductance-polytope criterion resolves all positive triples on the first genuinely heterogeneous 3-spoke star; the unique finite step horizon and critical h^(-2) asymptotics provide practical nonnegative-step safeguards and explain a nontrivial resistance-sign boundary. These are structurally motivated, not arbitrary numerical slices.
